_comment: OPS-PREVERIFY-RED-UNREAD-W1 CH2 ratchet baseline (architect ruling Q-B). Per-file count of process.exit() calls in tracked scripts that emit a <GATE>_VERDICT= token. process.exit() abandons queued stdout writes to a pipe, so the token — printed last — can vanish (51 of 53 reds of publish-lane-preverify.yml). A NEW verdict-emitting script may not call process.exit(); a listed script may never exceed its count, and when it drops the count must drop here in the same commit. Enforced by tests/unit/verdict-exit-path.test.ts.
_measured: 2026-10-03 — the only script over the 64 KiB pipe cliff was scripts/check-publish-lane-preverify.mjs, fixed in the same commit and therefore absent here. Every entry below relays a small output (largest measured piped output 5,026 B, ≥13x headroom), so this is enumerated debt, not a live outage.
_piped_consumer: true = this script's token IS read through a pipe or a $(...) capture by a WIRED consumer (CI workflow, git hook, host cron), at the place named in `consumer` — measured by the Plan-Mode inheritor census plus the pre-landing review (which found the robots-allowlist cron the census missed). Not counted: the manual scripts/gates/*.sh wave gates, and hooks that gate on the exit code with `|| exit 1`. These are the subset to migrate first.

ops/monitoring/served-region-check.mjs.consumer: signal-1 host cron ops/cron/nav-drift-canary.sh + ops/cron/analytics-drift-canary.sh `$(...)` + sed of SERVED_REGION_VERDICT

scripts/check-chat-id-literals.mjs.consumer: .github/workflows/deploy.yml `$(...)` + grep, and the pre-push hook scripts/install_chat_id_literals_hook.sh `$(...)` + grep (missing => INDETERMINATE => block)
